title: Proposed $100 cut to Head F of the Estimates withdrawn after debate on political integrity and grassroots advisers
what_it_is: A proposed $100 reduction to Head F of the Estimates, moved by Ms He Ting Ru and later withdrawn.
why_it_matters: The record does not set out the practical impact. The proposed $100 cut to Head F was withdrawn, and no change to funding or rules is stated.

key_points.point: Ms He Ting Ru moved to reduce the total sum allocated for Head F of the Estimates by $100.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: That the total sum to be allocated for Head F of the Estimates be reduced by $100.

key_points.point: She said political dominance should not be mistaken for political stability.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: Yet, we must not mistake political dominance for political stability.

key_points.point: She said the Workers' Party continues to push for stronger parliamentary institutions through electoral reforms or select committee work.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: This is why the Workers' Party (WP) continues to push for the further strengthening of our parliamentary institutions, whether through electoral reforms or select committee work

key_points.point: She proposed cooling-off periods between partisan and non-partisan roles.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: A step is to introduce cooling off periods between partisan and non-partisan roles, allowing individuals to meaningfully detach from previous associations.

key_points.point: She said distinctions between partisan and non-partisan roles should also apply to those leaving political appointments, the presidency and senior public sector roles.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: Distinctions between partisan and non-partisan roles should apply to those leaving political appointments, the presidency and senior public sector roles too.

key_points.point: She said public servants seeking political office should observe a cooling-off period.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: Public servants seeking political office should observe a cooling-off period.

key_points.point: She said political appointees and senior public servants leaving service should not immediately be employed in areas they last oversaw or regulated.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: Political appointees and senior public servants leaving service office should not immediately be employed in areas they last oversaw or regulated to avoid actual or apparent conflicts of interest.

key_points.point: She cited the Code of Corporate Governance requirement that independent directors generally have a three-year gap from a prior executive role.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: independent directors must generally have a three-year gap from any prior executive role before being regarded as independent.

key_points.point: She asked whether the grassroots advisor role is a non-partisan public function or a partisan extension of the governing party's ground operations.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: Is the role of the grassroots advisor a non-partisan public function or is it a partisan extension of the governing party's ground operations?

key_points.point: She said the present design of the grassroots advisors system attempts both non-partisan theory and political alignment in practice.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: The present design of the grassroots advisors system attempts both: non-partisan in theory while requiring political alignment in practice.

key_points.point: She said the PA budget, provided by taxpayers, should be scrutinised.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: And relatedly, we should scrutinise the PA budget, which is provided by taxpayers with these considerations

key_points.point: Ms Indranee Rajah said the gist of the cut was strengthening parliamentary democracy and safeguarding democracy in a changing world.
key_points.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: the gist of this cut was strengthening parliamentary democracy and safeguarding democracy in a changing world.

key_points.point: She listed symptoms of democratic malaise including polarisation, deep divisions and legislative paralysis.
key_points.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: This malaise is marked by the following symptoms: polarisation, deep divisions with no space for a middle ground, sometimes resulting in legislative paralysis

key_points.point: She said Singapore's Parliamentary democracy is not in such a parlous state.
key_points.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: We can be thankful that our Parliamentary democracy is not in such a parlous state.

key_points.point: She said safeguarding parliamentary democracy requires proper laws and respect for the rule of law.
key_points.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: First, there must be proper laws, coupled with respect for the rule of law.

key_points.point: She said integrity is also required.
key_points.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: Second, integrity.

key_points.point: She said the right people are needed.
key_points.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: Third, the right people.

key_points.point: On cooling-off periods, she said if Ms He resigned from the WP and declared that, there is no obstacle to her becoming an NMP the following day, provided she carries out those duties properly.
key_points.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: The answer is, if she resigned from the WP and declared that, there is no obstacle to her becoming an NMP the following day, provided that when she, assuming she is selected, carries out those duties as an NMP properly.

key_points.point: She said if someone moves from a non-partisan position to a partisan role, the right thing is to step down and say they intend to have or are exploring a partisan role.
key_points.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: then the right thing to do would be to step down from your non-partisan position and say to the world that you intend to have a partisan role or are exploring a partisan role.

key_points.point: She said the role of grassroots advisors is not a Parliamentary matter and was wrongly discussed under Head F.
key_points.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: Firstly, that is not a Parliamentary matter and is wrongly discussed under Head F.

key_points.point: She said she would not address grassroots advisors in detail, and that Minister Ong Ye Kung had answered the matter in an earlier session.
key_points.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: I do not propose to address it in detail, other than to say that this has been answered quite fully by Minister Ong Ye Kung in a separate earlier session of Parliament

key_points.point: She cited DPM Goh Chok Tong's 1988 speech on the Hendrickson affair and three political models.
key_points.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: He cited three political models: one, the American system of checks and balances

key_points.point: She quoted Confucius on governing by setting oneself right.
key_points.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: To govern is to set things right. If you begin by setting yourself right, who will dare deviate from the right?

key_points.point: In clarification, Ms He asked whether directors or former executive officers stepping down and declaring independence would suffice under the three-year cooling-off in the code of corporate governance.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
key_points.quote: So, is the Minister saying that if directors or formerly executive officers in a company actually step down and declare that they are henceforth independent, that that would suffice?

key_points.point: She said some WP MPs were tasked by the WP Central Executive Committee to look into the matter of Secretary-General Pritam Singh, and that this was an internal party disciplinary matter.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
key_points.quote: I just wanted to set the record straight that even though some of the WP MPs were tasked by the WP Central Executive Committee to look into the matter of our Secretary-General, Mr Pritam Singh, this was an internal party disciplinary matter.

key_points.point: She said none of the limbs of the Motion tabled before Parliament were about contravening the party's constitution.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
key_points.quote: None of them were about contravening the party's constitution, which is what we were tasked to look into

key_points.point: She said she could not support the Motion because of its many limbs.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
key_points.quote: I felt that because of the many limbs in there, I felt that was something that I could not support.

key_points.point: Ms Indranee Rajah said she does not have to look at the code of governance for directors, as it is a regime for directors.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: I do not have to look at the code of governance for directors. That is a regime for directors.

key_points.point: She said what matters is the right and appropriate conduct for MPs.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: What is of importance is what is the right and appropriate conduct for MPs, and I have outlined that earlier.

key_points.point: She said the resolution discussed did touch on matters for the WP Central Executive Committee or disciplinary tribunal to look at.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: the resolution that was discussed did touch on matters which will be something that the Central Executive Committee or the disciplinary tribunal of the WP has to look at.

key_points.point: The Chairman invited Ms He to withdraw her amendment.
key_points.speaker: The Chairman
key_points.quote: Ms He, I would like to invite you to withdraw your amendment.

key_points.point: Ms He withdrew her amendment.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
key_points.quote: I beg leave to withdraw my amendment.

what_happens_next: Ms He Ting Ru withdrew her amendment after the Chairman invited her to do so; no further step is stated.
not_said: Will cooling-off periods for partisan and non-partisan roles be introduced, and if so, for which offices?
How will grassroots advisers be classified as partisan or non-partisan?
What changes, if any, will follow for the People's Association budget or its scrutiny?
What is the outcome of the WP internal disciplinary proceedings concerning Mr Pritam Singh?
Does the three-year cooling-off in the Code of Corporate Governance apply by analogy to MPs?
What specific electoral reforms or select committee changes are proposed?
What practical effect, if any, will the debate have on the funding of Head F?

_dropped.quote: I would not be breaking any rules if I retired from electoral politics, quit the WP, left
